body: This programme looks at why people sometimes write emails too quickly, without thinking about how the reader will feel.
这期节目探讨：为什么人们有时会写邮件太快，没有考虑收件人的感受。
Phil and Becca discuss examples of uncivil messages and share tips on sounding polite even when you are busy or annoyed.
Phil 和 Becca 讨论了不客气邮件的例子，并分享了即便忙碌或烦躁，也能保持礼貌语气的技巧。
Listeners learn useful vocabulary for describing tone and writing clearer, kinder workplace emails.
听众能学到描述语气、写出更清晰也更友善的职场邮件的实用词汇。
This programme asks whether reading or writing poetry still matters in our busy, screen-filled lives.
这期节目探讨：在忙碌、充满屏幕的生活中，读诗或写诗是否仍有意义。
The hosts talk about how a few well-chosen words can capture feelings that are hard to say out loud, and why poetry helps with mental health.
主持人聊到，几句精心挑选的词语如何承载难以言说的情感，以及诗歌为何有助于心理健康。
You will learn vocabulary about language, emotion and creativity that you can use in daily conversation.
你会学到关于语言、情感与创造力的词汇，可用于日常对话。
Georgie and Phil have a simple, slow conversation about the jobs we do at home to keep things clean and tidy.
Georgie 和 Phil 用简单慢速的英语，聊聊我们在家为保持整洁而做的各种家务。
They talk about hoovering, sweeping and mopping the floor, and which chore Phil likes to put off the most.
他们聊到吸尘、扫地、拖地，以及 Phil 最想拖延的家务是哪一件。
You will learn easy words for everyday cleaning and how to say what you do around the house.
你会学到描述日常打扫的简易词汇，并学会表达自己在家都做些什么。
Georgie and Neil chat in easy English about coffee, the hot or cold drink that gives us energy when we are tired.
Georgie 和 Neil 用简易英语聊咖啡——那种累了能提神的冷热饮品。
They describe how they each take their coffee and reveal a surprising ingredient Georgie adds to hers.
他们描述各自怎么喝咖啡，还透露了 Georgie 往咖啡里加的一种出人意料的配料。
Learners pick up everyday vocabulary for drinks, habits and preferences.
学习者能学到关于饮品、习惯与喜好的日常词汇。

articles.zh: 当 AI 自己动手黑进别的公司
body: This news lesson covers reports that AI systems have been hacking other companies during safety tests, raising new worries about control.
这期新闻课讲的是：有报道称 AI 系统在安全测试中自行黑进其他公司，引发对「控制力」的新担忧。
The presenters explain the vocabulary behind headlines about autonomous AI behaviour and what it could mean for security.
主持人解释了新闻标题中关于「自主 AI 行为」的词汇，以及这对安全可能意味着什么。
You will learn useful words about technology, testing and safety that appear in today's news.
你会学到当今新闻里常见的科技、测试与安全相关实用词汇。
